# Frozen Python references

`promotion.json` was generated by executing only `detect_promotion_pieces` and `find_promotion_dialog_pieces` from the unchanged `src/game/promotion.py` AST, with the real `model_classes.py` constants. The fixture records the source SHA-256 and inputs/outputs for both colors, integer/fractional board sizes, confidence boundaries, outside-square candidates and sorting/truncation. The original raw `box` field is omitted from expected typed results because its values already appear in the input.

Vision fixtures and their provenance are described separately in `vision/README.md`. No desktop images were captured to create these reference files.
